state.goal: Choose hosting for a container that processes document uploads
state.question: Which hosting plan fits the service data persistence requirements?
known_constraints: the container must be reachable over HTTPS
required data must survive routine redeployments
evidence: Scenario DEPLOY baseline: traffic is small and steady; both offered plans support the image, HTTPS, adequate CPU, and memory.
Scenario DEPLOY baseline: the offered managed plan has ephemeral local storage and no persistent volume option; the offered virtual server has a persistent disk and scheduled backups.
Scenario DEPLOY baseline: the application team has not confirmed whether uploads and processing checkpoints must stay on local disk or are already externalized.
These capabilities describe the two fictional evaluation plans only, not all managed platforms or all virtual servers.

alternatives.name: Offered managed container plan
alternatives.description: Run on the offered plan with ephemeral local storage, built-in HTTPS, and no attachable persistent volume.
disadvantages: this plan has no persistent disk option

alternatives.name: Offered persistent-disk server
alternatives.description: Run the image on the offered virtual server with persistent disk, HTTPS configuration, and scheduled backups.
advantages: durable local storage across container replacement
disadvantages: team maintains the host and HTTPS configuration
